newsitem.title: KENYA: AFP correspondent detained in Eritrea since April.
newsitem.headline: AFP correspondent detained in Eritrea since April.

text.p: The Agence France-Presse correspondent in Eritrea, Ruth Simon, has been in detention since April, the French news agency said.

In a report published late on Wednesday AFP said it believed Simon, an Eritrean, was arrested on April 25. It said despite its numerous inquiries, the government in Asmara had not announced any charges against her or said where she was being held.

AFP said the day before her arrest Simon reported that President Isaias Afewerki told a seminar in Asmara at which she was present that Eritrean soldiers were fighting alongside rebels in neighbouring Sudan.
The ruling People's Front for Democracy and Justice called the report a "gross distortion" and repeated its denial of involvement in Sudan's civil war.
Sudan's opposition military and political coalition, the National Democratic Alliance, is based in Asmara.
Simon, married with two children including a baby aged six months, fought as a guerrilla during Eritrea's war of independence against Ethiopia.

AFP said that in reply to a letter to Afewerki from chairman Jean Miot the Eritrean foreign ministry said Simon's case was being dealt with under a press law which stated that "any journalist who disinforms the public or any institution is liable to the damage he/she may cause as a result".
"It is, therefore, (a) purely legal issue which does not require or allow any kind of intervention from any comer," the ministry said.
